name: Polaroid Photo Dump
summary: Switch seventeen photos inside an instant-film frame on satin, one every two beats of a bundled CC0 track, with a slow zoom, film grade and editable caption.

compatibility.selects: Uses existing Panel saved-Draft reads and SDK stat/readRange for plugin-private source verification; no SDK/client change is required. Working-copy checks precede one save; independent saved-source verification follows it. Unconfirmed reads retain the saved Draft ID without replay. Installed-app/Windows, playback and export remain unverified.
